name: bEarn BUSD/ibBUSD withdrawal-unit mismatch
summary: The BUSD Alpaca strategy's withdraw(address,uint256) passed a BUSD-denominated request to FairLaunch as an ibBUSD amount. Because each ibBUSD was worth more than one BUSD, repeated deposit/emergencyWithdraw cycles withdrew excess BUSD and compounded the attacker's credit.
notes: The direct BUSD Alpaca strategy was deployed with the flawed withdrawal-unit handling and its runtime remained byte-identical immediately before the incident.

bEarn reports that 26 attack transactions beginning with the anchored transaction drained 10,859,319 BUSD from the affected single-stake BUSD vault. The campaign-wide amount is valued at stablecoin par; it is not narrowed to the first transaction's proceeds.
The campaign-wide BUSD amount follows bEarn's primary post-mortem rather than a complete structured set of all 26 attack transaction hashes.
The defect-executing target is the direct BUSD Alpaca strategy, not the bVault bank proxy through which users entered and exited the strategy.
